answer: Voter registration attestation keeps fake identities off the electoral roll. A newcomer shows a registration record from the public roll, and the election office confirms the name, address, and polling place against its registry. A record tied to another identity is rejected, and members must re-confirm at each election. One honest voter spends nothing and five minutes, while 1,000 fakes need 1,000 forged registrations at $200 each, or $200,000. Lotus certifies the roll entry, Umber holds the registry, Canyon keeps the voters honest.
